title: Neural network pruning: what you can delete, and what quietly breaks
summary: Ada and Alan teach pruning, from Optimal Brain Damage's curvature-based saliency through train-prune-retrain, the lottery ticket, one-shot LLM pruning with SparseGPT and Wanda, layer and expert removal, and the evidence that perplexity hides what pruned models forget.

concepts_taught: neural network pruning: saliency beyond magnitude (Optimal Brain Damage's curvature-times-weight-squared), train-prune-retrain, unstructured versus structured and 2:4 sparsity, the lottery ticket and its rewinding caveat, one-shot LLM pruning (SparseGPT's layer-wise reconstruction, Wanda's weight-times-activation score), layer and expert removal (REAP), and the evidence that perplexity hides long-tail and knowledge-intensive damage
